subject.title: [Bug]: tools/sandbox: MEDIA_MAX_BYTES (5 MB) is hardcoded and not user-configurable

question: What size-limit contract should govern media-store and sandbox-staging files, including the default, hard maximum, and precedence with existing `mediaMaxMb` settings?
rationale: The issue is source-reproducible, but changing this cap changes sandbox, disk, memory, and message-delivery resource boundaries, so automation should not choose the permanent contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Define A Bounded Shared Cap
options.body: Add a documented, validated store/staging limit with secure defaults and a hard maximum, then update all affected callers to use it consistently.

options.title: Land Only The Telegram Slice
options.body: Review the focused Telegram document PR for immediate outbound relief while keeping this broader store/staging contract open.

options.title: Keep The Fixed Core Cap
options.body: Reject configurability and keep the fixed 5 MiB core cap, accepting larger-file failures outside narrower per-path exceptions.

recommendation.title: Define A Bounded Shared Cap
recommendation.body: Add a documented, validated store/staging limit with secure defaults and a hard maximum, then update all affected callers to use it consistently.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses sandbox and media-store security boundaries where steipete has the strongest relevant staging/security history signal.
